company.name: Trukkin
company.shortDescription: Trukkin is a is a digital freight and logistics platform that provides road transportation and supply chain operations.
company.description: Trukkin is a logistics technology company focused on digital freight and transportation management services. The platform connects businesses with transport providers for road cargo movement and supply chain operations. It offers tools for shipment tracking, fleet coordination, and logistics workflow management. The company primarily serves commercial transportation and freight distribution needs across regional markets.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $6,932,403, or 66.45% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $5,961,656 to $39,559,071, a 6.64x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 65 (+0 over 90 days) and market heat at 48 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
